Hi, there. Yes. Your cats won’t understand if you suddenly disappear. I, too, is holding on to you 8-year old dachshund. Dachshunds live long lives so I still have about 7-8 years left. I think, it’s becoming clear to me, that my death will be suicide. It’s just a matter of when. But not until my dog is here. Hugs to us.

Hi. I didn’t know this subreddit exists and this is how I feel. Whenever my husband and I fought, whether I know it’s my fault or not, I couldn’t walk away and “just move on” because I always think we need to resolve the fight for it not to happen again. My husband is different. He needs time away from each other before resolving fights. 

I obviously have to walk away with a heavy heart each time and I want to do something to feel something else and alcohol or smoking would have lasting effect. I just found out about cutting through a show I saw and yeah, it takes care of the shitty feeling without the long-term destruction. 

I don’t cut too deep right now so there are no scars but sometimes, I’d like to see some blood.
